display_name: Effects of Collagen Supplements on Skin Aging: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
document_title: Effects of Collagen Supplements on Skin Aging: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
what_it_supports: Oral collagen supplementation for prevention or treatment of skin aging.
limitations: This single review does not resolve all collagen indications, such as joint outcomes.
Do not generalize the skin-aging conclusion to every collagen product or outcome.
Formal GRADE appraisal has not yet been completed.
